item.tib: zab lam mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzogs ma rgyud gsas mkhar sde lnga'i thugs kyi sgrub pa man ngag gnad 'dus
item.coloph: bdag 'dra bdud 'dul gsang sngags grags pas gyim shod shel le rgya gar (skar) nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser la slar shing phag gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bzang por rang gi phu bo bla ma tshul khrims dbang rgyal nas rab dkar lha rdzas kyis bskul bzhin gtan la phab ste drung yig pa ni tshul khrims blo ldan pa'o//
